verdict.rationale: x402 documents the full agent-purchase loop: an agentic wallet/CDP account acts as delegated payment credential (docs-11, docs-21), the nine-step flow shows the client signing a payment on 402 challenge and the server confirming after settlement (supp-1), and a dedicated 'x402-enable a merchant checkout' integration lets agents authorize payment sessions directly (docs-13). Missing for 10: deeper documentation/example of a traditional multi-step 'checkout session' (vs single-request payment) and independent/hands-on corroboration of an actual confirmed e-commerce order beyond per-request API payment use cases seen in community posts.
